nodes.name: [Trigger] Schedule Every 5 Min
nodes.notes: Polls every 5 min so Pending→Cleared status flips are caught. A row-added trigger would miss updates to existing rows — see architecture.md for full justification.

nodes.name: [Config] Set Constants
nodes.notes: ALL literals live here. Update channel names and manager names when clinic contacts change. Replace MGR_* placeholders with real manager names before going live.

nodes.name: [Transform] Normalize Candidate Data
nodes.notes: Produces canonical schema. keepOnlySet:true removes raw sheet columns — all downstream nodes consume these field names only, never 'Candidate Name' or 'Email Address' directly.

nodes.name: [Validate] Run Field Checks
nodes.notes: Returns valid:true/false and a reasonCode. Only one reason code per row — first failing check wins. ALLOWED_CLINICS must exactly match the canonical values in [Config] Set Constants.

value.Notes: Row failed pre-sync validation — not written to Airtable

nodes.name: [Route] Branch on BG Status
nodes.notes: Output 0=Cleared→upsert. Output 1=Failed→audit. Output 2=Pending→audit. Output 3=Unknown→audit. Explicit 4th rule catches any unexpected status value.

value.Notes: ={{ 'Background check status is ' + ($json.bgStatusNormalized ?? 'unknown') + ' — row intentionally skipped, not an error' }}
={{ 'Unexpected Background Check Status value: "' + ($json.bgStatusNormalized ?? '') + '" — review sheet data' }}

nodes.name: [Airtable] Upsert Staff Record
nodes.notes: Upsert key: Email Address. Re-running on the same row updates the existing record — zero duplicates guaranteed. continueErrorOutput routes API failures to [Error] Alert on Airtable Failure without stopping the workflow.

parameters.text:
=':red_circle: *Airtable Upsert Failed*

*Candidate:* ' + ($json.candidateName ?? 'Unknown') + ' (' + ($json.emailNormalized ?? 'no email') + ')
*Node:* [Airtable] Upsert Staff Record
*Error:* ' + ($json.error?.message ?? 'Unknown error') + '
*Timestamp:* ' + $now.toISO() + '
*Execution ID:* ' + $execution.id

nodes.name: [Error] Alert on Airtable Failure
nodes.notes: Receives the error output from [Airtable] Upsert Staff Record. $json.error.message contains the Airtable API error. $execution.id links to the n8n execution log for debugging.

nodes.name: [Route] Switch on Clinic Location
nodes.notes: Routes to clinic-specific Slack channel. Fallback wires to [Audit] Log Unknown Status as a defensive catch — unreachable in practice since [Validate] Run Field Checks guards this path.
